title: Infinite Porch
description: Connect computers you own with people you choose, with explicit permissions for messaging, storage, and bounded tasks.
detail: Infinite Porch is a local-first peer network with device identities, explicit trust, and bounded grants. Its networking foundation supports sharing by choice; the personal digital home and its Hall of Brothers are the imaginative world behind this print.
art: An amber-lit wooden porch opens into a corridor of doors, each revealing a different universe.
alt: Infinite Porch chrome-title poster: a warm wooden porch, a cat at the doorway, and an endless cosmic hallway.

title: Infinite Commons
description: Shared artifact handoffs meet Midnight Sierra: a growing browser experience of warm terraces, city studies, and personal spaces.
detail: Infinite Commons provides a small deterministic contract for loading shared artifact bundles. Its optional Midnight Sierra experience adds an illustrated arrival terrace and an evolving 3D city prototype, with local previews of owner-selected spaces.
art: A quiet terrace overlooks a glowing city of gardens, towers, and skywalks beneath a violet sky.
alt: Infinite Commons chrome-title poster of an Art Deco future city viewed from a cozy balcony with a chair and radio.

title: Super Φ.Vessel
description: Vessie brings models, memory, tools, evidence, and human approvals into an experimental cognitive operating layer.
detail: Super Φ.Vessel explores how local models, hosted inference, memory, research, and tools can work together while keeping capability separate from permission. Its project site, operator manual, and local console document the evolving system.
art: A tactile command console faces a crystalline intelligence core, suspended against a vast nebula.
alt: Super Phi Vessel chrome-title poster of a cosmic command chamber with analog controls and a suspended crystal core.

title: Nested Bubble/Gear
description: A mathematical and computational research framework exploring hidden internal structure and the limits of observation.
detail: Nested Bubble/Gear studies when states that appear identical through an observer's Keyhole can behave differently under later interactions. Its site gathers reproducible toy experiments, controls, interactive labs, and explicit boundaries around what the results establish.
art: Nested glass bubbles and intricate gear rings reveal their hidden interior through a single beam of light.
alt: Nested Bubble Gear chrome-title poster of iridescent nested spheres, gold gear rings, and light entering through a keyhole.

title: Domistika
description: A browser art studio for drawing, layered painting, radial composition, symmetry, and geometric experiments.
detail: Domistika is an independent browser art application with creative rooms, layered projects, radial composition tools, and a public SDK. Its creative handoffs preserve the distinction between previewing an artwork and deliberately importing it.
art: An ivory CRT becomes the doorway to an immense mandala of light, impossible stairs, and luminous petals.
alt: Domistika chrome-title poster showing a vintage computer beneath a brilliant radial world of petals and impossible architecture.

title: MoreBounceLabs
description: Mikey More Bounce's music house: an album vault, listening lounge, radio, visual lab, and two DJ decks.
detail: MoreBounceLabs brings the artist's catalog into a local-first listening experience with playlists, a visual lab, and a two-deck workspace. Playback options depend on the actual audio source, with official embeds and artist-hosted audio treated separately.
art: Two chrome turntables send a ribbon of sound into the stars above a warm record-filled lounge.
alt: MoreBounceLabs chrome-title poster with two vinyl turntables, a mixer, record shelves, and a cosmic ribbon of sound.

title: Auralith369
description: A visual-alchemy workstation for image editing, poster forging, style cards, and traceable creative exports.
detail: Auralith369 is a public-alpha creative workstation that runs locally in the browser. It combines image editing, style transformations, poster composition, project manifests, and creative receipts, including a bounded handoff from Domistika.
art: Layered image plates pass through a brilliant prism in a richly detailed analog-future workshop.
alt: Auralith369 chrome-title poster of an optical workbench transforming layered mountain images into a glowing aurora artwork.

title: The Silicon Louvre
description: An independent digital museum exploring optical art, perception, imagination, and human–AI collaboration.
detail: The Silicon Louvre presents original optical-art studies through gallery walks, framed spatial displays, and documented creative credits. Its exhibitions keep code-generated studies and image-generated works distinct while celebrating both.
art: A monumental chrome ribbon floats among optical artworks in a star-lit museum atrium.
alt: Silicon Louvre chrome-title poster of a gold-and-blue museum with optical artworks and a huge reflective ribbon sculpture.

title: OpenBlue
description: Draft rooms, schematics, network drops, and conceptual rack layouts, then explore a 3D design preview.
detail: OpenBlue continues the OpenBlueprint Studio project as a local-first concept-design tool. It combines 2D drafting, room annotations, network planning, local project checkpoints, and a 3D preview. The GitHub repository retains its original OpenBlueprintStudio name.
art: A luminous architectural model rises from blueprints beside a network rack and an amber drafting lamp.
alt: OpenBlue chrome-title poster of a drafting table with blueprints, a cyan architectural model, and a network equipment rack.

title: Parallax PixelForge
description: A retro Creator OS for building, playtesting, packaging, and evolving small game worlds.
detail: PixelForge separates its game-making studio from its reusable runtime contracts. The project includes creator tooling, original game worlds, a 3D world studio, and deliberate local asset handoffs, with human review still part of the creative process.
art: Colored cubes assemble into floating islands, tiny castles, and playful creatures above a creator's workbench.
alt: Parallax PixelForge chrome-title poster of a retro workstation forging floating game islands from luminous colored cubes.

title: PhiCade
description: A local retro-game runtime where people, scripts, replays, and AI controllers share a governed control interface.
detail: PhiCade makes controller permissions, runtime capabilities, and replay evidence explicit. It can connect to supported game runtimes and original PixelForge cartridges. This is a local application; setup instructions are available in its repository.
art: A cosmic arcade stretches toward a ringed planet as a tiny game world spills out of a cabinet.
alt: PhiCade chrome-title poster of a cosmic arcade with a gold robot on a CRT and glowing platforms emerging into the room.

title: Pulse 369
description: An original browser VR fitness and rave studio with rhythm movement, uploaded music, and gentle recovery.
detail: Pulse 369 combines desktop practice and compatible WebXR sessions with original environments, rhythm targets, training paths, and guided recovery activities. Its movement coaches are local game agents. The project began on Larrina's workstation with Mikey's creative direction.
art: An athlete traces purple and lime arcs through a spectacular orbital neon temple.
alt: Pulse 369 chrome-title poster of an adult wearing a VR headset and reaching toward purple and lime targets in a cosmic temple.

title: BrainC
description: A self-hosted AI assistant built around local Ollama models, private memory, and useful tools.
detail: BrainC pairs a Python/FastAPI backend with a streaming chat interface, locally stored memory, and optional tools. It belongs on the owner's own machine; the repository provides the installation and operating instructions.
art: A copper neural computer glows beside a cream CRT in a quiet, wood-and-brass home study.
alt: BrainC chrome-title poster of a transparent desktop computer with a glowing neural lattice in a cozy night-time study.

title: PocketBrain
description: A phone-first AI workspace with browser-local memory and optional user-configured model bridges.
detail: PocketBrain explores a private personal AI that remembers on the user's device. Browser-local inference is the default path, with encrypted backups and optional bridges to stronger configured models. Feature availability depends on the device and selected provider.
art: A miniature constellation of memories lives inside a silver pocket computer resting on an explorer's notebook.
alt: PocketBrain chrome-title poster of a small silver handheld with a luminous brain and memory images inside its screen.

title: PorchTalk
description: Explore model collaboration across a neighborhood of devices while respecting consent, privacy, and compute budgets.
detail: PorchTalk is an experimental local-first inference-routing policy and protocol prototype. The hosted React control room visualizes fictional devices and simulated decisions; it does not itself grant access to real computers or execute their models.
art: Delicate ribbons of light connect selected homes beyond a warm porch with two mugs and a retro intercom.
alt: PorchTalk chrome-title poster of a warm porch looking across a hillside neighborhood connected by a few glowing ribbons.

title: The Field Atlas
description: A cozy living book of public projects, with themed wings, a discovery compass, and guided exploration.
detail: The Field Atlas gathers public GitHub Pages projects into a book-centered library. Visitors can browse themed wings, follow discovery trails, open project previews, and keep a browser-local explorer's passport.
art: An open atlas becomes a landscape of little worlds, joined by golden paths in a star-lit library.
alt: The Field Atlas chrome-title poster of an open book containing floating miniature worlds in a warm library.

title: The More Bounce Method
description: An evolving human practice for honesty, accountability, understanding, interconnection, contribution, and curiosity.
detail: The More Bounce Method offers six B.O.U.N.C.E. practices, a public manifesto, and gentle reflection prompts. Its Foundation Principle connects honesty, repair, and learning to the shared future we build for people we may never meet.
art: Six solid foundations support a shared workshop and garden, while small acts of care ripple toward the future.
alt: The More Bounce Method chrome-title poster of people tending a community garden and workshop above six stone-and-bronze supports.

title: GLO Pin
description: Dustin's Good Lookin' Out idea: a local-first resource map for water, charging, and covered public seating.
detail: GLO Pin turns Dustin's original community-resource concept into a free, accountless map with private on-device observations. People choose when to request location or online map tiles. Resource observations are reports rather than guarantees of current availability.
art: An emerald glass map pin lights a welcoming public plaza with water, charging, seating, and people helping one another.
alt: GLO Pin chrome-title poster of a luminous green map pin in a future public plaza with a water fountain, charging, and covered seating.
